summary.zh: 公元前647年，亚述国王亚述巴尼拔为报复埃兰人长期的袭扰，率军攻陷并摧毁埃兰都城苏萨。亚述军队掠走神庙与王宫财物，捣毁神像，并掘开埃兰历代王陵。此役后埃兰作为政治实体不复存在，亚述一度成为西亚唯一的霸主，但过度扩张也加速了其自身的衰落。
summary.en: In 647 BC the Assyrian king Ashurbanipal, retaliating for Elamite attacks, stormed and destroyed Susa, the Elamite capital. His army looted its temples and palaces, smashed the statues of its gods and desecrated the royal tombs; Elam ceased to exist as a political entity and Assyria briefly stood without a rival in western Asia.

significance.zh: 苏萨之战终结了埃兰的独立，是亚述帝国扩张的顶点，也为其随后的迅速崩溃埋下伏笔。
significance.en: Susa ended Elamite independence and marked the height of the Assyrian empire, foreshadowing its own rapid collapse.

summary.zh: 公元前458年，罗马共和国与埃魁人在拉丁姆的阿尔基杜斯山交战。罗马独裁官辛辛纳图斯率援军赶到，将一度危急的战局转为胜利，据传统记载他随后即交还独裁官职权返回农耕。此役是罗马与埃魁人长期冲突中的重要一战，也是辛辛纳图斯形象的主要来源。
summary.en: In 458 BC the Roman Republic and the Aequi fought at Mount Algidus in Latium. The dictator Lucius Quinctius Cincinnatus arrived with a relief force and turned an expected defeat into a victory, and tradition records that he then laid down the dictatorship and returned to his farm. The battle is the main source of his later reputation.

significance.zh: 阿尔基杜斯山之战巩固了罗马对拉丁姆的控制，也使辛辛纳图斯成为罗马共和美德的典范人物。
significance.en: Mount Algidus secured Roman control of Latium and made Cincinnatus the model of republican virtue.

title.en: Battle of the Ascent of Lebonah

summary.zh: 公元前167年或前166年，马加比起义最初阶段，犹大·马加比率少量游击队伍在从撒马利亚通往耶路撒冷的勒波纳坡道伏击阿波罗尼乌斯率领的撒马利亚军队并将其击败。这是马加比人对外作战的首场胜利，见于马加比一书开头。战役的确切地点与日期均无定论。
summary.en: In 167 or 166 BCE, at the very start of the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus and a small guerrilla band ambushed and defeated the Samaritan force of Apollonius on the ascent of Lebonah on the road from Samaria to Jerusalem. It was the Maccabees' first victory over a foreign army; neither the site nor the date is certain.

significance.zh: 勒波纳坡道之战是马加比起义的首场胜利，为随后一系列反抗塞琉古的作战开了先例。
significance.en: The ascent of Lebonah was the first Maccabean victory and set the pattern for the revolt against the Seleucids.

summary.zh: 公元前166年春至前165年春之间，马加比起义初期，犹大·马加比率起义军在贝特霍伦山口伏击塞琉古将领塞隆的军队，将其击溃并追击至平原。此役是马加比起义早期的胜利，起义军随后又与阿波罗尼乌斯、吕西阿斯等部交战。具体日期史料未详，学界一般系于前166年。
summary.en: Between spring 166 and spring 165 BC, early in the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus ambushed and routed the Seleucid force of Seron in the Beth Horon pass and pursued the survivors into the plain. It was an early rebel victory, followed by further fighting against Apollonius and Lysias; the exact date is not recorded.

significance.zh: 贝特霍伦之战是马加比起义早期的关键胜利，显示了游击战术在山地隘口的威力。
significance.en: Beth Horon was an early Maccabean victory that showed how effective guerrilla tactics were in the hill passes.

summary.zh: 公元前165年9月前后，马加比起义期间，犹大·马加比率起义军在埃茅斯附近迎战塞琉古帝国军队。起义军连夜行军突袭敌军营地，趁大批士兵外出之机将其击溃，并缴获大量物资与武器。此役是马加比起义中一次重要的胜利，为随后清剿塞琉古驻军与收复耶路撒冷创造了条件。
summary.en: Around September 165 BC, during the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus and his rebels met a Seleucid force near Emmaus. Marching by night, the rebels surprised the camp while many soldiers were absent and routed it, seizing valuables and weapons. It was an important victory that prepared the way for clearing Seleucid garrisons.

significance.zh: 埃茅斯之战以夜袭取胜，为马加比人随后肃清塞琉古驻军、收复耶路撒冷奠定了基础。
significance.en: Emmaus was won by a night surprise and prepared the Maccabean recovery of Jerusalem from its Seleucid garrison.

summary.zh: 公元前164年10月，犹大·马加比率起义军在贝特祖尔迎战吕西阿斯统率的塞琉古军队。按马加比书记载叛军获胜，但战果是否具有决定性存在争议。战后安条克四世的死讯传到塞琉古军营，吕西阿斯撤军回首都处理继承问题，马加比人得以随即夺取耶路撒冷。
summary.en: In October 164 BC Judas Maccabeus and his rebels met the Seleucid army of Lysias at Beth Zur. The books of Maccabees record a rebel victory, though how decisive it was remains disputed; news of the death of Antiochus IV then reached the Seleucid camp, which withdrew to deal with the succession, and the Maccabees took Jerusalem soon afterwards.

significance.zh: 贝特祖尔之战后塞琉古军因王位继承危机撤退，为马加比人收复耶路撒冷与重建圣殿打开了道路。
significance.en: After Beth Zur the Seleucid army withdrew over a succession crisis, opening the way for the Maccabees to recover Jerusalem and rededicate the Temple.

significance.en: Beth Zechariah was one of the few heavy defeats of the Maccabean revolt and brought the Seleucid army to Jerusalem.

summary.zh: 公元前129年，塞琉古国王安条克七世西代特斯与帕提亚国王弗拉特斯二世在埃克巴坦那附近决战。安条克战败身亡，塞琉古帝国收复东方失地的最后一次努力失败，其领土此后基本局限于叙利亚一带。此役确立了帕提亚在两河流域以东的优势，也终结了塞琉古王朝重返东方的传统。
summary.en: In 129 BC the Seleucid king Antiochus VII Sidetes and the Parthian king Phraates II fought near Ecbatana. Antiochus was defeated and killed; the last Seleucid attempt to recover the eastern lands failed and their territory was thereafter largely confined to Syria. The battle confirmed Parthian dominance east of Mesopotamia.

significance.zh: 埃克巴坦那之战终结了塞琉古帝国重返东方的企图，帕提亚由此成为西亚大国。
significance.en: Ecbatana ended the Seleucid bid to recover the east and established Parthia as the leading power of western Asia.

summary.zh: 公元66年，第一次犹太-罗马战争初期，叙利亚总督加卢斯率第十二军团及辅助部队自耶路撒冷撤退途中，在贝特霍伦隘口遭犹大起义军伏击。罗马军队惨败，约六千人阵亡，军团鹰旗被缴获。此役极大鼓舞了起义，导致犹太短暂自治，也迫使罗马此后投入更多兵力镇压。
summary.en: In 66 CE, early in the First Jewish-Roman War, the legate of Syria Cestius Gallus and his Legio XII Fulminata were ambushed by Jewish rebels in the Beth Horon pass while retreating from Jerusalem. Some 6,000 Roman troops were killed and the legion's eagle was captured; the defeat encouraged the revolt and forced Rome to commit far larger forces.

significance.zh: 贝特霍伦之战是第一次犹太-罗马战争中罗马最惨重的失败之一，直接延长并扩大了起义。
significance.en: Beth Horon was one of Rome's worst defeats in the First Jewish-Roman War and directly prolonged and widened the revolt.

significance.en: Orleans shows how rival military powers divided Gaul after the Western Roman collapse, and it checked Visigothic expansion towards the Loire.

summary.zh: 公元485年，据《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》记载，撒克逊首领埃勒率军在莫克雷德斯伯恩与不列颠人交战，这是埃勒在苏塞克斯建立王国的三场战役之一。编年史记其前有477年的西门斯霍雷之战、后有491年的佩文西之战。此役的确切地点与规模已不可考，是南撒克逊王国起源传说的一部分。

significance.zh: 莫克雷德斯伯恩之战是南撒克逊王国建立传说的一环，也是早期苏塞克斯历史的少数文献线索之一。
significance.en: Mercredesburne belongs to the foundation story of the South Saxons and is one of the few documentary traces of early Sussex.

summary.zh: 1072年1月初，卡斯蒂利亚国王桑乔二世在卡里翁德洛斯孔德斯附近的戈尔佩赫拉击败其弟莱昂国王阿方索六世，阿方索被迫流亡。此役是基督教诸王国之间的内斗，熙德也参与其中。桑乔随后兼并莱昂，但同年即在萨莫拉围城期间遇刺身亡，阿方索得以复位并统一两国王冠。
summary.en: In early January 1072 Sancho II of Castile defeated his brother Alfonso VI of Leon at Golpejera near Carrion de los Condes, forcing Alfonso into exile. significance.zh: 戈尔佩赫拉之战使桑乔二世短暂统一卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂，其遇刺又让阿方索六世成为两国的统治者。
significance.en: Golpejera briefly united Castile and Leon under Sancho II, whose murder then handed both crowns to Alfonso VI.

significance.en: Kletsk was the most decisive Lithuanian victory over the Crimean Tatars and temporarily secured the duchy's southern frontier.

summary.zh: 1804年10月5日，拿破仑战争期间，格雷厄姆·摩尔准将率英国舰队在圣玛丽亚角外袭击布斯塔曼特指挥的西班牙分舰队。当时英西尚处和平，英方获知该舰队正从蒙得维的亚运送白银回国，遂予拦截：一艘西班牙护卫舰被摧毁，另外三艘被俘，白银无一运抵西班牙，同年12月西班牙对英宣战。
summary.en: On 5 October 1804, during the Napoleonic Wars, Commodore Graham Moore's squadron attacked a Spanish squadron under Jose de Bustamante off Cape Santa Maria. Although Britain and Spain were at peace, the British had learned that the Spanish ships were carrying silver from Montevideo to Cadiz; one frigate was destroyed and three captured, and none of the silver reached Spain.

significance.zh: 1804年10月5日海战直接促使西班牙对英国宣战，把西班牙推入拿破仑一方，改变了海上力量对比。
significance.en: The action of 5 October 1804 pushed Spain into declaring war on Britain and into Napoleon's camp, shifting the naval balance.

significance.en: Suipacha was the first decisive republican victory over the Royalists in the Rio de la Plata region and lifted the independence movement's morale.

significance.en: Crysler's Farm and Chateauguay together defeated the American Saint Lawrence campaign of 1813 and saved Montreal.

significance.en: Mulayda ended the Second Saudi State and sent the Saud family into exile, from which its eventual restoration created modern Saudi Arabia.

significance.en: Manila ended Spanish rule in the Philippines through a staged battle and planted the seeds of the Philippine-American conflict.

summary.zh: 2015年底至2016年2月，伊拉克军队在国际联盟空袭支援下发起反攻，从伊斯兰国手中夺回安巴尔省首府拉马迪。联军经过两个半月的战斗于2016年2月收复该城，其间空袭超过850次。拉马迪在战斗中遭到严重破坏，据估计全城约九成建筑受损，是伊拉克战争中破坏最严重的城市之一。
summary.en: From late 2015 to February 2016 Iraqi forces, supported by coalition air strikes, counter-attacked to retake Ramadi in Anbar Province from Islamic State. After two and a half months of fighting the city was recaptured in February 2016, with more than 850 air strikes flown; Ramadi was left among the most damaged cities of the Iraq war.

significance.zh: 拉马迪收复战是伊拉克军队2015年后首次夺回省会城市，标志打击伊斯兰国战事的转折。
significance.en: The recapture of Ramadi was the first provincial capital Iraq retook after 2015 and marked a turning point against Islamic State.
